statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry with vendorProject Progress Software carrying a dateAdded value between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one vulnerability record whose vendorProject field is Progress Software and whose dateAdded field falls between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV record carries vendorProject Progress Software with a dateAdded inside that window.

statement: LexisNexis Risk Solutions reports a data breach affecting 100000 or more individuals to the Maine Attorney General between 2026-08-11 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Maine AG data breach notification database lists a filing by LexisNexis Risk Solutions or a LexisNexis entity, dated 2026-08-11 through 2026-12-31, with total affected of 100000 or more.
failure_condition: No such filing appears, or every LexisNexis filing in the window reports fewer than 100000 affected individuals.

statement: NYMEX front-month WTI crude settles at or below 72.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-11 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if CME official settlement data for the front-month NYMEX WTI light sweet crude contract shows a settlement price of 72.00 or lower on any trading day from 2026-08-11 through 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI settlement in that window prints above 72.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: NYMEX front-month WTI crude settles at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if CME official settlement data for the front-month NYMEX WTI light sweet crude contract shows a settlement price of 100.00 or higher on any trading day from 2026-08-11 through 2026-10-30.
failure_condition: No front-month WTI settlement in that window reaches 100.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield closes at or above 5.00 percent on at least one business day between 2026-08-11 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 records a value of 5.00 or greater on any business day from 2026-08-11 through 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 observation in that window is below 5.00 percent.

statement: A Ukrainian long-range strike on an oil refinery in Tatarstan, Bashkortostan, or Samara oblast occurs between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, or BBC report such a strike dated in that window and a Russian regional governor, the refinery operator, or Russian federal authorities acknowledge it.
failure_condition: No refinery in those three regions is struck by Ukrainian long-range weapons during the window.

statement: Iranian forces seize or forcibly board at least one commercial merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if UKMTO issues an incident advisory describing an Iranian seizure or boarding of a merchant vessel in that area within the window and at least one of Reuters, AP, or AFP reports the same incident.
failure_condition: No Iranian seizure or forcible boarding of a merchant vessel occurs in that area during the window.

statement: The Israeli cabinet or security cabinet formally approves the United States 15-point Gaza plan between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Israeli Prime Minister Office or Government Press Office announces cabinet approval of that plan within the window and both Reuters and AP report the approval.
failure_condition: No Israeli cabinet vote approving the 15-point plan is announced during the window.

statement: USGS catalogs at least one magnitude 5.5 or greater earthquake within 200 kilometers of the 2026-08-10 western Colombia M7.4 epicenter between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-07.
resolution: TRUE if the USGS earthquake catalog lists an event of magnitude 5.5 or greater with origin time in that window and epicenter within 200 kilometers of event us6000tjl2.
failure_condition: No M5.5 or greater event in the USGS catalog meets both the distance and origin-time conditions.

statement: Daniel Kinahan is surrendered or extradited from Irish custody into United States custody between 2026-08-11 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if a United States Department of Justice statement or at least two of Reuters, AP, and BBC report that Kinahan has been transferred from Ireland into US custody within that window.
failure_condition: Kinahan remains outside United States custody at the deadline.
